name: bitstamp-mcp
description: Bitstamp (trading): list_markets, get_ticker, get_candles. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: GET /api/v2/markets/ returns every market at once (no paging documented); the server sorts by symbol and pages locally (page/limit). `query` is not sent: the API has no text search (its only filter is `entity`). symbol is Bitstamp's url symbol, e.g. btcusd.

tools.name: get_ticker
tools.description: symbol is the market_symbol from list_markets, e.g. btcusd or etheur. Prices in the counter currency; volume is the last 24h volume in the base currency.

tools.name: get_candles
tools.description: interval is one of 1m, 3m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 2h, 4h, 6h, 12h, 1d, 3d (the documented step values 60…259200 seconds); returns the latest `limit` candles (max 1000), oldest first. time is the candle open in UTC.
